text: Policy gap "Attention" is neither clearly an emotion nor clearly a physical state (type: missing standard). - *Conflict:* eu-ai-act-2024-1689 (Art. 3(39), Recital 18) and ec-guidelines-prohibited-ai-practices-2025 exclude fatigue but prohibit inferring students' attention. ieee-7014-2024 explicitly covers cognitive states. - *Example:* https://www.insideprivacy.com/artificial-intelligence/european-commission-guidelines-on-prohibited-ai-practices-under-the-eu-artificial-intelligence-act/ - *Type:* missing standard. Documents: ec-guidelines-prohibited-ai-practices-2025 eu-ai-act-2024-1689 ieee-7014-2024.

Policy gap The education ban may block assistive use by neurodivergent students (type: conflicting objectives). The medical exception in eu-ai-act-2024-1689 Art. 5(1)(f) is undefined for non-device support tools. A student's voluntary ADHD aid inside a university platform may be prohibited, while the same tool used at home is not. un-crpd-2006 accommodation duties (unverified) point the other way. - *Example:* https://epale.ec.europa.eu/en/content/commission-guidelines-prohibited-ai-practices-education - *Type:* conflicting objectives. Documents: eu-ai-act-2024-1689 un-crpd-2006.

Policy gap Wellness vs. medical claims diverge across jurisdictions (type: coordination problem). - *Conflict:* fda-general-wellness-2026 allows non-invasive sensing with wellness claims. mdcg-2019-11-rev1 treats "alleviation of disability" as a medical purpose. - *Silent:* I found no published Gulf wellness carve-out. - *Example:* https://www.cov.com/en/news-and-insights/insights/2026/01/fda-issues-revised-guidance-on-general-wellness-products - *Type:* coordination problem. Documents: fda-general-wellness-2026 mdcg-2019-11-rev1.

Policy gap Non-identifying physiological signals fall through definitional cracks (type: legislative gap). - us-coppa-rule-2025-amendments §312.2(10) lists gait, face and voice but not HRV or EDA. - eu-gdpr-2016-679 Art. 9 covers them only if they count as health data. - *Example:* https://www.privacylawnetwork.com/news/coppa-rule-2025-amendments.html - *Type:* legislative gap. Documents: eu-gdpr-2016-679 us-coppa-rule-2025-amendments.

Policy gap The UAE has no operative detail for sensitive data (type: unclear responsibility). The Art. 28 Executive Regulations of uae-pdpl-fdl-45-2021 are still unissued, and Art. 2 carves health data out to sectoral law. It is unclear which regime governs inferred attention data. - *Example:* https://www.uaeexperthub.com/uae-data-protection-law-pdpl/ - *Type:* unclear responsibility. Documents: uae-pdpl-fdl-45-2021.

Policy gap Qatar's permit model does not scale to consumer apps (type: missing standard). qatar-pdppl-13-2016 Art. 16 requires a permit for any health, psychological-condition or child data. I found no published fast-track or sandbox for low-risk support tools. - *Example:* https://assurance.ncsa.gov.qa/sites/default/files/library/2022-12/Privacy%20Notice%20-%20Guideline%20for%20Regulated%20Entities.pdf - *Type:* missing standard. Documents: qatar-pdppl-13-2016.

Policy gap Therapeutic nudging collides with anti-persuasive-design rules (type: conflicting objectives). None of these rules has an exception for reminders or rewards the user chose for their own support: - eu-dsa-art28-minors-guidelines-2025 §6.4; - uk-ico-age-appropriate-design-code Standard 13; - eu-ai-act-2024-1689 Art. 5(1)(b). - *Example:* https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/library/commission-publishes-guidelines-protection-minors - *Type:* conflicting objectives. Documents: eu-ai-act-2024-1689 eu-dsa-art28-minors-guidelines-2025 uk-ico-age-appropriate-design-code.

Policy gap No standard for validating the accuracy of inferred states (type: missing standard). iso-iec-23894-2023, imdrf-n81-2025 and ieee-7014-2024 set no accuracy, bias or false-alert thresholds for wearable attention inference in neurodivergent populations. - *Example:* no verified precedent found. - *Type:* missing standard. Documents: ieee-7014-2024 imdrf-n81-2025 iso-iec-23894-2023.

Policy gap Binding duties for private apps are delayed (type: legislative gap). eu-digital-omnibus-ai-2026-1744 pushes Annex III oversight and conformity duties to 2 December 2027. bahrain-ai-general-policy-2025 binds only government entities. - *Example:* https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-eu-ai-act-high-risk-deadline-omnibus-20260/ - *Type:* legislative gap. Documents: bahrain-ai-general-policy-2025 eu-digital-omnibus-ai-2026-1744.

Policy gap Public-sector assurance stops at procurement (type: unclear responsibility). nt-ai-assurance-framework and bahrain-ai-general-policy-2025 bind agencies, not vendors. A school-procured ADHD app's duties therefore depend on its contract. - *Example:* https://dcdd.nt.gov.au/publications/artificial-intelligence-policy - *Type:* unclear responsibility. Documents: bahrain-ai-general-policy-2025 nt-ai-assurance-framework.

Policy gap No binding neurodiversity-specific accessibility standard exists (type: missing standard). - w3c-wcag-2-2 covers only some cognitive criteria. - w3c-coga-usable-2021 is a non-normative Note. - un-pact-future-gdc-a-res-79-1 and unesco-rec-ethics-ai-2021 mention inclusion generally. - *Example:* none verified. - *Type:* missing standard. Documents: un-pact-future-gdc-a-res-79-1 unesco-rec-ethics-ai-2021 w3c-coga-usable-2021 w3c-wcag-2-2.

Policy gap The ITU ML standards are silent on harms to people (type: coordination problem). itu-t-y3172 and itu-t-y3173-y3174 have no hooks for consent, special-category data or user override. itu-ai-ready-report-2-0 lists "standards" as a readiness factor without mapping health or child protections. - *Example:* https://www.itu.int/rec/dologin_pub.asp?lang=s&id=T-REC-Y.Sup96-202511-I%21%21PDF-E&type=items - *Type:* coordination problem. Documents: itu-ai-ready-report-2-0 itu-t-y3172 itu-t-y3173-y3174.
